newsitem.title: USA: Family Dollar sees Sept same store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Family Dollar sees Sept same store sales off.

text.p: Discount store chain Family Dollar Stores Inc said on Thursday its same-store sales for September declined about 3.2 percent from the same period last year.

Sales in September 1996 were hurt by the fact that there were four Fridays and four Saturdays in the month this year compared to five Fridays and five Saturdays in September 1995, the company said in a statement.
The company also said it distributed an advertising circular in the last week of September, but in 1996 the advertising circular was moved to the first week of October.
The timing of the circular depressed sales in September but would add to sales in October, it said.
Due to the shift in the advertising circular, the company said comparable stores sales would increase significantly in October 1996.
Family Dollar said sales in September 1996 were about $126.7 million, 3.2 percent above September 1995's sales of $122.8 million.
